conclusion: Return-conditioned KV learning produces a repeatable held-out trajectory-separation signal and a paired online gain on Bluetooth under the same structured action policy. Wi-Fi still fails, so cross-task online validation is not yet complete.

positive_only_action_auxiliary.interpretation: Best joint offline result: preserves return separation and improves ranking, but does not change top-1 decisions.

fork_and_coordinate_preferences.overfit_control: Ten click-focused epochs increased return margin to 0.4130 but collapsed Top-1 to 0.1667; rejected by the ranking gate.

state_router.input: 24x24 RGB screenshot plus normalized history length
state_router.online_status: Pending rerun after software-emulator rendering/system_server instability; black-screen router probes are excluded.

online.system_task_free_form: No successful learned-policy rollout observed, including alpha=8 and eight-step evaluations. The positive-only action auxiliary produced legal JSON (0 invalid actions) but repeated swipe-down for all eight Wi-Fi steps and returned 0.
online.candidate_ranking: Hierarchical type-then-parameter ranking plus a generic loop guard converts the learned coordinate preference into executable actions.
online.wifi_probe: Both baseline and KV remain unsuccessful. The policy clicks before the quick-settings shade is fully expanded, identifying state routing as the remaining failure.
online.go_no_go: Single-task online gate passed reproducibly; cross-task gate remains pending. Do not claim broad end-to-end success until a learned state router or equivalent structured policy passes Wi-Fi and additional tasks.
